sloka: तं राजमार्गस्थममित्रघातिनं वनौकसस्ते सहसा बहिः स्थिताः ।दृष्ट्वा ऽप्रमेयं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पं वितत्रसुस्ते हरियूथपालाः ।। ६.६०.९७ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ rājamārgasthamamitraghātinaṁ vanaukasaste sahasā bahiḥ sthitāḥ ।dṛṣṭvā 'prameyaṁ giriśṛṅgakalpaṁ vitatrasuste hariyūthapālāḥ ।। 6.60.97 ।।।।

translations.english: Oppressed with fear the Vanaras ran here and there seeing the form of Kumbhakarna that was like the peak of a mountain as if touching the selfluminous Sun, crowned and wonderful, grown in size. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
